name: Dashboard shows a red bar with an Armed label while armed
step: Dashboard shows a red bar with an Armed label while armed
rationale:
Issue #2352 (armed part only): a model on the ground was shown on the dashboard
with no visual warning that the rotor can spool up. The dashboard now draws a red
bar across the top edge with an "Armed" label hanging from its centre over whatever
theme is shown while the FC reports the armed state, and draws nothing red while
disarmed. The setting "Armed warning" in Settings > General (default on) switches
it off; the dashboard widget has no property of its own for it.

No build and no package step reaches this -- it is a paint path through a running
widget. The harness drives the real widgets/dashboard.lua paint with a recording
lcd and feeds the arm state through session.update the way the session does. It
switches the setting on the real app/pages/settings_general.lua and presses Save,
so the dashboard sees it through the settings.update the page publishes. It
requires the red bar and the label while armed, no other red rectangle, nothing
red while disarmed or while the setting is off, and no widget property. Against
master before the setting moved to Settings > General, 9 of 19 checks fail.
